method.class: Regression-based global average treatment effect (GATE) estimator under network interference: fit an outcome regression on treatment-assignment-derived exposure features (own treatment, neighbour-treated fraction/count, optional graph/covariate features) from a single randomized experiment, then predict outcomes under all-treated and all-control assignments and take the mean difference, with resampling-based uncertainty.
method.description: On the declared 8-case synthetic grid (SBM, Barabasi-Albert, Watts-Strogatz graphs with n~3000; additive, stronger, nonlinear, degree-dependent and 2-hop interference; Bernoulli and block-cluster randomization), the frozen regression-based estimator's relative GATE error (RMSE, bias, CI coverage) is measured on 24 unseen seeds per case and compared with difference-in-means, a linear exposure-regression baseline and neighbourhood-exposure Horvitz-Thompson; error is attributed to interference strength, graph family/degree, nonlinearity, spillover range and assignment design only through the single-factor case contrasts, and the conclusion is scoped to these mechanisms and sizes (supported, refuted or conditional per case, not general).

baselines: linear_regression_adjustment (evaluator-owned Chin-style OLS of outcome on own treatment, treated-neighbour fraction and covariates, predicted under all-treated vs all-control; the reference regression-based GATE estimator)
horvitz_thompson_neighbourhood_exposure (evaluator-owned full-neighbourhood-exposure HT estimator using the known design probabilities, Ugander et al.)
protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility: `correct` (declared transcript of 64 production resets plus one mandatory trailing replay of seed 101/C1 with exactly one reset per episode; all primary and control responses schema-valid, finite and lo<=est<=hi; all four evaluator baselines ran and the oracle passes its sanity bound; controls non-vacuous and constant-outcome control within 1e-4 of 0; replay reproduces the first-run estimate; instance hashes match the plane manifest with zero search/final overlap). Rank eligible candidates by higher combined_score (= -mean over 8 cases of per-case RMSE of clipped relative GATE error); exact ties (1e-9) broken by lower worst per-case rmse, then earlier evaluation index. At most 3 search evaluations; freeze the best eligible program_0/src by content hash; final plane runs once on the frozen code. Comparative thresholds against baselines are not search vetoes (task.md specifies none); final claims (paired bootstrap-over-seeds vs baselines, negative-control reading, supported/refuted/conditional per case) are assessed separately and are not part of `correct`.

search_proxies.name: reduced_seed_count_search_plane
search_proxies.preserves: Same 8-case grid, generators, assignment designs, aggregation hierarchy, negative controls, baselines, RPC protocol and wall-clock structure as final; evaluator-owned truth.
search_proxies.omits: The 24 sealed final seeds and instance realizations, and the statistical power of 24 seeds per case (search uses 8 seeds per case).

search_proxies.name: search_score_not_final_claim
search_proxies.preserves: Per-case relative-error RMSE, coverage, width and control behaviour measured against the evaluator-computed true GATE.
search_proxies.omits: Final claim assessment (paired bootstrap intervals, supported/refuted/conditional labels) and any sealed final control results.

candidate stderr and untrusted diagnostics, truncated

final per-episode true GATE, estimates, intervals and baseline outputs

required_evidence: Provenance record: SHA-256 of task.md, of evaluator, case specs, generator code and frozen program_0/src; pinned dependency versions; offline install procedure; every number/table/figure traceable to a script that was actually run.

Payload preflight report with measured UTF-8 JSON bytes, base64 expansion, envelope and framing of the largest request/response against the 64 MiB limit, and the per-operation RPC count against max_candidate_rpc_calls.

Reset transcript evidence: broker-observed global transcripts equal the declared search/final sequences (cardinality, seed order, one reset per episode) with at most one trailing replay; replay determinism result.
Search/final disjointness report: disjoint seeds plus zero normalized content-hash overlap for graph and graph+treatment+outcome instances, run before candidate featurization.

Final-plane results table: per-case and overall rmse_rel, signed bias, bias-variance decomposition, CI coverage and width for the candidate and all four baselines, with bootstrap-over-seeds confidence intervals and paired comparisons; direction and tie policy stated; failed/missing episodes shown with their worst-case contributions.

Single-factor attribution analysis (strength, design, nonlinearity, spillover range, graph family/degree) from the declared case contrasts, with explicit statement that factors are not fully crossed and conclusions are limited to the grid; failure/negative cases (e.g. nonlinear and 2-hop misspecification) reported honestly.
Negative-control results (permuted outcomes, permuted graph, constant outcome): vacuity checks, expected behaviour and observed behaviour, with no causal conclusion drawn from a vacuous control.

Statement separating enforced limits (wall-clock, per-episode cap, broker RPC count) from advisory candidate-internal counts (resampling, optimizer iterations), and the trusted evaluator-owned source of every metric and correctness criterion.

Separate reports of scientific validity, search eligibility/ranking/freeze decision (<=3 search evaluations) and final claim assessment, plus the bounded scope statement: synthetic graphs only, n~3000, public graphs not used, no real platform data; smoke evidence labelled as reduced-work and not as production completion.

Task-mandated paper deliverables downstream: LaTeX source and PDF in an ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS latest-template with checklist, reproduction notes (environment, seeds, commands, expected runtime), and a literature-access compliance record confirming that the excluded published paper and its derivatives were not consulted.
